in_marathi.name: Taksh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of power, strength, and courage
in_marathi.long_meaning: Taksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Taksh is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'takshanah' meaning 'God of power, strength, and courage'. In Hindu mythology, Taksh is the name of the deity associated with power, strength, and courage. This name is often given to babies to instill a sense of confidence and bravery in them.
